notes.title: Hello! こんにちは ! 안녕하세요 ! 你好 !
notes.content:
We have added 3 new languages ​​for our game and a couple of other small improvements.

Our team consists of only 2 people, so if you see any errors in the translation and are ready to help us, write to us at giantdwarfsgames@gmail.com

Happy running everyone!

notes.title: Bug fixes and small improvements
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We released a small update where we fixed the bugs that we found in the first week.

-Fixed achievements that are impossible to complete
-Fixed dreams that are impossible to fulfill
-Matadors no longer freeze after jumping
-Heatmap view improved

We also reworked the corner flag a bit. Now it is not reset automatically, but only by pressing a button.

notes.title: We are released. What awaits us next.
notes.content:
Hi, Streakers!

Our game is finally out, and we are very glad that many of you liked it.

We [b]Giant Dwarf[/b] want to share the plans that await the game in the near future.

[b]First of all, we will release a small update[/b], where we will fix bugs, and add small improvements to the mechanics (for example, how the flag works).
We want to add more translations in different languages
Also we will implement some general improvements.

After that, we will work on the development of the first expansion, which will introduce [b]new enemies and a new madness mode[/b].

In the next big update, we want to [b]add new streakers with unique abilities[/b] to make it more fun to run around the field.
Each new streaker will have their own challenges.

Of course, all [b]add-ons will be free[/b] and will be included in the main version of the game.
We want to develop the game so that everyone can get the most out of it.

Stay tuned there will be new details and happy runs for everybody!!!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249899/3afd9622d8c346a3fac9bdbe369ffc0f33bedbf1.gif[/img]

notes.title: Football Streaker Simulator is coming soon!
notes.content:
Yep, that's right! Welcome to "Football Streaker Simulator" - the game where you become a shameless streaker on the football field!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249899/a386c1dbd1f051d1280d31012a52ab4aedf5a97f.gif[/img]

Your mission is simple - run through the exciting stadiums during football matches, while avoiding security guards, players, and even referees! It won't be easy, but completing fun challenges and achieving your dreams will make it worth it.

And guess what? We're not done yet! We're working hard to add even cooler stuff to the game.

So, stay tuned for the news and get ready to enjoy the crazy fun of "Football Streaker Simulator." 
Are you up for the challenge? Welcome on a field!
